title: Single-name move screen 2026-11-04 (router-gated): 93 passed, index-only while B is gated
body_md: D1 2026-11-04 single-name move screen, ROUTER-GATED MODE (Strategy B DO-NOT-ACTIVATE). Population: US-listed common stocks with market cap >= $2B and |close-to-close| >= 5% on 2026-11-04 against 2026-11-03. Discovery from key-less Nasdaq closes measured 2009 names; 666 cleared 5% on that basis on a broad rally day (discovery median +2.3%). Event identity from the key-less Nasdaq earnings calendar and one scripted EDGAR submissions batch only; no metered call. 93 names with a stamped own-event release in the reaction window were confirmed >= 5% on IBKR regular-session bars and pass (index-only watchlist adds while B is gated). 10 near-floor names fell below 5% on IBKR and were dropped. 574 rejected names are carried in rejected_compact by code with discovery-basis closes. No deal-pinned target. Close-chain: 2 forward-chain hits (DUOL, NVTS) against the unlanded 2026-11-03 row, both legitimate after-close anchors.

fields.legacy_rule: move >= 5% close-to-close (Strategy B frozen Entry criterion 1; mechanical record-only benchmark; legacy_rule_pass=true on every item here)
fields.selection_rule: Symbol list and marketCap from the key-less Nasdaq screener (its pctchange lags and was not used): 2013 listed names with marketCap >= $2B after excluding non-common preferreds/warrants/notes/bonds; the 382 screener rows with no marketCap were not measured. Moves found from per-symbol Nasdaq quote/info regular-session closes dated 'Closed at Nov 4, 2026' (prior close = close minus netChange; discovery only). Names with >=4.5% on that basis were labelled from the key-less Nasdaq earnings calendar (schedule only) and one scripted EDGAR data.sec.gov/submissions batch (form, items 2.02/7.01/8.01/1.01/4.02 or 6-K, acceptanceDateTime); no Tavily, web_search, WebFetch or FMP call was made. Layer 2 then measured on IBKR regular-session daily bars (close array, ONE_DAY, outside_rth=false, ONE_MONTH; search_contracts paced under its 30/min limit) EVERY name with a stamped own-event filing in the reaction window (after the 2026-11-03 21:00Z close to the 2026-11-04 21:00Z close): 125 names (114 at >=5% discovery, 11 at 4.5-5.0%) plus 5 names with no Nasdaq Nov-4 print. All 114 IBKR-measured names with a >=5% discovery move cleared 5% on IBKR (largest discovery-vs-IBKR gap 0.63pp for the $1.6 stock UWMC, next 0.28pp, mostly <0.2pp); 10 near-floor names (4.5-5.0% discovery) fell below 5% on IBKR and are in dropped_below_floor_ibkr, VSH rose to -5.07% on IBKR and passed. Filing text was then read: 22 names whose only window filing does not explain the move (annual-meeting results, call-date notice, dividend, credit agreement, notes offering, AGM notice, presentation-only, PDMR/buy-back notices, 6-K press releases whose exhibit could not be read: SII, LKFT, LEGN) went to ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED. Source limit: free primary sources only (router-gated), so a name with no own filing in the window is ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED. prior_qualifying_* counts other >=5% IBKR close-to-close sessions in the 10 sessions before the reaction session (2026-10-21 to 2026-11-03); conviction heuristic (copied from the prior run): >=3 prior => 30, 2 prior => 45, else |move|>=15 => 75, |move|>=10 => 60, else 45.
